$comment: Section contract. content is a JSON Schema fragment; every $ref (#/definitions/...) resolves inside schema/pagespec.schema.json, where this exact fragment is embedded as definitions.content_shell-lines-divider (verify_all.py checks they are identical). maxWords = ceil(1.25 x real observed max), min observed+1; x-observedMaxWords records the real observed count.
purpose: Full-width hairline band that separates content bands; the page's main rhythm device (10 page-level instances).

horizontal-10rem.description: 8rem vertical strip used INSIDE narrative.problem / narrative.solution; never a PageSpec node.

horizontal-3rem.description: 3rem vertical strip used INSIDE features.industries-grid; never a PageSpec node.

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Static hairline band; nothing to reduce.
motion.fallbackNote: The original site has no prefers-reduced-motion handling (cite:spec-no-reduced-motion); this fallback is design-repo policy, not measured source behaviour.
